steps.title: Branch, plan and pinned crypto dependencies
steps.summary: Branch phase-02-core-crypto from main (Phases 0–1 merged as 4ef461d); plan in status.json; crypto crates pinned in core/Cargo.toml with every version justified in DECISIONS.md.

steps.title: Foundations: random, labels, CryptoError
steps.summary: One OsRng-backed random function; every HKDF label as a constant in labels.rs; a thiserror CryptoError with no secret data in messages.

steps.title: secret_key: SP1 format
steps.summary: Generate 128 bits, encode to SP1-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XX with a BLAKE3 check character, decode with Crockford normalisation; reject bad length, bad checksum and set pad bits.

steps.title: aad: typed builder and canonical CBOR
steps.summary: Deterministic CBOR with RFC 8949 key ordering; closed record-type enum; the API makes encrypting without an AAD impossible.

steps.title: aead: XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope
steps.summary: seal/open with a 24-byte OsRng nonce, strict envelope parsing, suite check, hard error on any failure.

steps.title: kdf: NFKC + Argon2id to MUK, HKDF sub-keys
steps.summary: derive_muk with the SPEC parameters and anti-downgrade minimums, derive_subkey, auth secret; small params only in unit tests.

steps.title: keys: newtypes and wrap/unwrap
steps.summary: MasterUnlockKey, AccountKey, VaultKey, ItemKey over Zeroizing<[u8;32]>, redacted Debug, no Clone; wrap/unwrap AK, VK, IK and field keys with per-object salts.

steps.title: signing: device keys, certificates, revocations
steps.summary: Ed25519 device and identity keys, domain-separated certificate/revocation/enrolment bodies, verification with account binding, future-skew check and revocation cut-off.

steps.title: hpke: X25519 seal/open plus a KEM trait
steps.summary: HPKE base mode X25519/HKDF-SHA256/ChaCha20Poly1305 with the SPEC info and aad binding; a trait so the Phase 11 X-Wing upgrade is a swap, not a rewrite.

steps.title: Tests: round-trip, tamper matrix, proptest, vectors
steps.summary: core/tests with round-trips for every public function, a tamper matrix (nonce, ciphertext, tag, every AAD field, wrong suite, wrong key), proptest properties, known-answer vectors in core/tests/vectors/v1.json and one #[ignore] real-parameter Argon2 test.

steps.title: crypto_tour example and preview card
steps.summary: cargo run -p studge-core --example crypto_tour walks a fake account through the SP1 Secret Key, Argon2id timing, wrapping, field encryption and three attacks that each print 'rejected'. The preview page has a Crypto tour card with the command and an Expected line; light/dark screenshots captured.

steps.title: Self-attack review, PROGRESS entry and PR
steps.summary: 18 crypto attack vectors reviewed: 15 blocked by named tests, 3 accepted (R-0117..R-0119, issues #36/#37). PROGRESS.md entry written, THREAT_MODEL section 16 added, PR #38 closes #8.

steps.title: Review fix 1: signatures cover the BLAKE3 digest
steps.summary: signing_digest() added; certificates, revocations and enrolment proofs sign and verify the digest (SPEC 4.7 updated, D-0207); vectors regenerated with cert_digest_hex and the revocation fields; tests prove a raw-body signature fails.

steps.title: Review fix 2: timestamps are real calendar dates
steps.summary: Timestamp::parse round-trips through Unix seconds, rejecting impossible dates and second 60; the revocation cut-off compares numerically.

steps.title: Review fix 3: zeroize working buffers
steps.summary: NFKC password, Secret-Key decode buffers, HPKE secret copy and signing seed are all zeroizing (AGENTS rule 4).

steps.title: Review fix 4: reproducible vectors
steps.summary: hpke and ak_wrap marked kind=decrypt-only; the generator writes only with STUDGE_WRITE_VECTORS=1 and otherwise fails on drift in the deterministic sections.

steps.title: Review fix 5: documentation
steps.summary: PROGRESS.md shows Phase 0 and Phase 1 merged and records the review fixes; PR #38 description and this dashboard updated.

risks.title: R-0001 — CodeQL code scanning skipped while the repository is private (issue #23)
R-0103 — A cloned VM or broken RNG could repeat a nonce; mitigated by OsRng-only random and no software fallback
R-0108 — A weak master password plus a stolen Secret Key allows offline guessing; Argon2id 64 MiB/t=3/p=1 is the mitigation
R-0116 — Vault-key wrapping is X25519-only; hpke 0.15 now ships X-Wing, so Phase 11 can switch
R-0117 — test-vectors feature exposes fixed-nonce sealing; documented test-only, never in release builds
R-0118 — The Secret Key check character is 5 bits: a typo inside the alphabet has a 1-in-32 chance of passing and then fails safely at the MUK
R-0119 — HPKE base mode gives no sender authentication; correct for vault-key wrapping, must not be presented as authentication
